oh! ok,

*Benefits:*
  - No more `div` injection in host screen.
  - When you inspect element while render update, the screen display both at same time. No more race condition for visual priority.

*Limitations:*
  - Repaint frequency, when the user scrolls. We have to clear the canvas.
  - The canvas relies on `pointer-events: none` of Popover API to let the user event pass through the canvas layer. It may conflict with highly aggresive global event & unusual way of event handling by the user.
